auditor_finding.claim: Outside B3-E, selecting the first longest SBA option chooses the keyed option 153 times in 234 questions (65.4%); mean keyed-option length is 97.9 characters against 79.1 for distractors.
auditor_finding.existing_detector_limit: scripts/check_structural_patterns.py detects only a per-item outlier when the correct option is at least 1.6 times the longest distractor and at least 6 tokens longer. It does not test aggregate bank-level predictability.

mechanical_reproduction.method: Enumerate every data/questions JSON at the baseline ref, restrict to question_type SBA, take max(choices, key=len(choice.text)) using repository order as the deterministic first-max tie break, and test whether that choice id is keyed. B3-E membership is the question_hashes key set in AUDIT-CLAUDE-FRESH-B3E-V3-REALISM-INITIAL-2026-08-20.

minimum_repair_candidate_check.scope: Uncommitted seven-question minimum-deficit repair candidate derived from baseline_sha
minimum_repair_candidate_check.interpretation: The narrow repairs remove the per-item leakage gate failure introduced in MA-Q-0203 but do not remediate the bank-wide aggregate signal. The aggregate debt therefore remains explicit rather than being misrepresented as fixed.

controller_disposition.basis: The controlling Batch 3 resume contract explicitly carries this as an auditor-side bank-wide debt and states that it is not a completion blocker under the current gate set. The controller may not retroactively replace that gate with a new bank-wide rewrite requirement.
follow_up_required_after_batch3: Design and approve an aggregate SBA answer-length predictability gate with a frozen tie policy and threshold.
Measure released-only, pending-only and full-bank cohorts separately so lifecycle composition cannot mask the signal.
Repair in independently audited tranches; do not bulk-edit keys or option text without current-hash legal and realism review.
